verdict.rationale: LM Studio's docs and product design center on downloading and running LLMs entirely locally (llama.cpp/MLX), including offline RAG, a local REST API, and a headless CLI/daemon mode — all without requiring cloud round-trips. Community feedback corroborates it as a genuine local-inference tool used in place of cloud APIs, and even the voice feature explicitly states audio 'is processed locally and never leaves your device.' Missing for 10: independent audit confirming zero network calls/telemetry, and clarity on whether optional network-exposed server mode affects the privacy guarantee.
